title: Round 8 — 06c1df7f: A/B of the three fixes on the real stack
subtitle: Old arm = round-7 build d472033c (bundle + Broker jar kept aside); new arm = 06c1df7f; MySQL 8.4.11; Hosted Harness -> Java Broker/SQL -> Runtime worker -> real MCP servers.
lines: ## R3-10 (my round-7 item): a raw resource_read that never answers
-- d472033c: op status 409, op cancel 409; three parallel status calls -> 409, 409, 409
++ 06c1df7f: op status 200 running, cancel 202 running; parallel status calls serialize -> 200, 409, 409
== prompt, detach and new raw ops stay 409 while the read runs (by design)
== default timeoutMs: the read ends at 602 s as outcome_unknown/managed_mcp_timeout; then blocked, detach 503, lease held
## R4-3: lone surrogate in a raw prompt_get argument (value "a\uD800b" or key "top\uDC00ic")
-- d472033c: forwarded after '?' substitution - the MCP server saw topic "a?b"; settled; Session fine, detach 204
!! 06c1df7f: Broker 400 before forwarding (server saw nothing) -> Harness records outcome_unknown -> Session blocked
!!    op cancel 202 outcome_unknown; detach 503; load in a new Harness 200 but still blocked, detach 503; lease held
++ candidate, 15 lines (route check before the record exists): 400 invalid_mcp_operation, 0 Broker requests,
++    next read settled, detach 204, lease 0; emoji control unchanged; 6 cli test files 163/163
## R4-1: a schema-invalid reply to a raw read
== quota not reachable from Hosted here: every Hosted Session has its own worker (8 Sessions -> 8 endpoints)
!! on both heads: one invalid reply -> outcome_unknown -> Session blocked, detach 503, lease held (not new)
## Mutants on this head's changes: 12/12 killed (cli baseline 163/163, broker 525 with 1 skipped)
++ V1-V6 status/cancel/close fences   V7-V9 in-flight quota   J11 Unicode guard   J12-J13 observe() merge

notes.text: R3-10 is fixed. The R4-3 guard is correct in the Broker, but the Harness turns its 400 into an unknown outcome, so one malformed string from a client permanently blocks the Session and its Workspace. On d472033c the same request only had its content changed.
